# Valentin Bedague

> Web designer & full stack developer based in Biarritz, France. I build iconic, high-performance, bilingual (FR/EN) websites that convert visitors into customers, from the first brief to the last pixel.

Valentin Bedague is an independent freelance web designer and developer. Services span design, custom development (React, Vite, Astro), SEO, e-commerce and long-term maintenance. Available for new projects. Reply guaranteed within 24h.

## Projects

- [Edible Table](https://valentinbedague.com/work/edible-table): Showcase & portfolio site for a private chef. Built with Astro 5 (static), vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, bilingual FR/EN, Web3Forms contact, SEO-optimised.
- [My Shampouineuse](https://valentinbedague.com/work/myshampouineuse): Showcase site for a professional cleaning company in Corsica. Full stack: design, custom booking back-end and SEO.
- [Unda Massage](https://valentinbedague.com/work/undamassage): Premium showcase site for a sports massage practitioner in Biarritz, with online booking.
- [TCXA Agency](https://valentinbedague.com/work/tcxa): B2B customer-experience consulting agency site.
- [Sport of Kings](https://valentinbedague.com/work/sportofkings): Sustainable fashion e-commerce store (Shopify), GOTS & OEKO-TEX certified.
